instructions: Read REVIEW.md. Every PR description has a Runtime evidence (Garnet) section between <!-- garnet:evidence:begin --> and <!-- garnet:evidence:end -->. Use it only when its <!-- garnet:commit <sha> --> marker equals the PR head; otherwise evidence is pending, never stale-ground. The section is a verbatim mirror of the trusted Garnet Runtime Review comment. Treat it as ground truth of the recorded run, then cross-check it against the diff. The machine register is <!-- garnet:summary {...} -->; branch on previous === null for snapshots, because comparison-only fields are null there. An execution chain is one root-to-action path; today's action class is an outbound connection. A destination is the leaf of an outbound action, never the definition of a chain. The headline is Execution Profiles recorded for <N> job(s); never claim true k-of-n coverage, and never render or claim chain counts from the human surface. In comparisons, + is current-only and − is previous-only. Never repeat verdicts, scores, severities, baselines, or safety judgments. Prefix every runtime-grounded statement exactly as: Runtime evidence (Garnet, head <sha7>): . A missing or pending record means no runtime evidence, not a clean run.
